_about: Companies that share a name, or a name stem, with a company in data.js but are NOT that company. Edited by hand; no script writes this file.

Read by scripts/fetch_deals.py (deal-feed headline matcher), scripts/fetch_curated_lists.py (BuildList / Black Flag watcher and the HQ cross-check) and scripts/fetch_vc_portfolio_watcher.py (name-only holdings).
context_guards: a funding headline credited to this data.js company is dropped when the headline or its summary matches not_if (a case-insensitive regex).

different_companies: `name` is a different company from every data.js record listed in `not`. A headline or list entry whose full name is `name` is never credited to those records. A data.js record whose own name is exactly `name` still matches normally.

Hadrian.note: hadrian.io is a Dutch security firm; ours is the Torrance precision-parts manufacturer (hadrian.co). Its $40M round was credited to ours in Oct 2026.

Observable Space.note: Observable (observablehq.com) is a data-visualisation software company; ours is the Los Angeles space-optics company (observable.space).

Parallel Systems.note: Parallel Web Systems (Parag Agrawal's AI web-search company) headlines as 'Parallel'; ours is the autonomous freight-rail company (moveparallel.com).

different_companies.note: Its own data.js record (NYC robotic stone carving, monumentallabs.co). Monumental is the Amsterdam bricklaying-robot company (monumental.co).
